title: ChroPlate - ProteinG
author: Alexandra Ehl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8qthvwn

steps.title: Prepare sample for binding
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to pH 7–8, ensure a NaCl concentration of 150–300 mM, and if needed add 1/11 volume of 10× PBS to achieve these conditions.

substeps.instruction: Adjust sample pH to 7–8.
Add NaCl to reach 150–300 mM.
Add 1/11 volume of 10× PBS (optional) to obtain the desired pH and ionic strength.

steps.title: Load sample (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add up to 1.5 ml sample to each well, and centrifuge 2–10 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor (2 min for ≤1 ml, >5 min for >1 ml or viscous samples). Keep flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

substeps.instruction: Place ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate.
Add ≤1.5 ml sample per well.
Centrifuge 2–10 min at 400 g (adjust time according to volume/viscosity).
Collect flow‑through for later analysis.

steps.title: First wash (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Empty the deep‑well plate (or place the ChroPlate on a clean one), add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl for nonspecific interactions), and centrifuge 2 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor. Use the dummy filter plate provided for counter‑balance.

substeps.instruction: Remove the deep‑well plate or replace with a clean one.
Add 500 µl wash buffer per well (add Tween‑20 ≤1 % and/or NaCl ≤0.5 M if needed).
Centrifuge 2 min at 400 g.
Include dummy filter plate for counter‑balance.

steps.title: Repeat wash (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash step two additional times (total of three washes) for increased purity.

steps.title: Elute protein (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add 300 µl elution buffer to each well, centrifuge 2 min at 400 g, and repeat this elution two more times (three elutions total).

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µl elution buffer per well.
Centrifuge 2 min at 400 g.
Repeat the addition and centrifugation two more times.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add one drop of neutralization solution to every well of the deep‑well plate and mix gently.

steps.title: Set up vacuum device
steps.instruction: Assemble the vacuum device according to the manufacturer’s instructions; ensure the dummy filter plate is positioned for counter‑balance.

steps.title: Load sample (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add up to 1.5 ml sample to each well, and apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2–3 min (longer for >1 ml or viscous samples). Keep flow‑through for later analysis. Ensure the sample pH is 7–8, NaCl 150–300 mM, and add 1/11 volume of 10× PBS if needed.

substeps.instruction: Place ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate.
Add ≤1.5 ml sample per well.
Apply vacuum 100 mbar for 2–3 min (adjust time for volume/viscosity).
Collect flow‑through for later analysis.

steps.title: First wash (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Empty the deep‑well plate (or place the ChroPlate on a clean one), add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl), and apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2 min. Note that frothing may occur when Tween‑20 is used with vacuum filtration.

substeps.instruction: Remove the deep‑well plate or replace with a clean one.
Add 500 µl wash buffer per well (add Tween‑20 ≤1 % and/or NaCl ≤0.5 M if needed).
Apply vacuum 100 mbar for 2 min.

steps.title: Repeat wash (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous vacuum wash step two additional times (total of three washes) for increased purity.

steps.title: Elute protein (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add 100 µl elution buffer to each well, apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2 min, and repeat this elution two more times (three elutions total).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl elution buffer per well.
Apply vacuum 100 mbar for 2 min.
Repeat the addition and vacuum two more times.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Add one drop of neutralization solution to every well of the deep‑well plate and mix gently.
